```python
import hamana

# Connect to the internal database
hamana.connect()

# Create and populate sample table
hamana.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT
    )
""")

hamana.execute("""
    INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (1, 'Alice'), (2, 'Bob'), (3, 'Charlie')
""")

# Wrap SQL string in Query object and execute
query = hamana.Query("SELECT id, name FROM users")
hamana.execute(query)

# Read results as pandas DataFrame
result_df = query.result

hamana.disconnect()

print(result_df)
```
